title: Sweden – household preparedness
disclaimer: Official guidance is translated into HomePrep planning primitives. Personal circumstances always take precedence.

sources.title: Important information to all residents of Sweden – Home preparedness
Hemberedskap – preppa för minst en vecka

recommendations.title: Stored emergency water
recommendations.advisory_note: MSB's current preparedness guidance states that at least three litres of water per day are needed, mainly for drinking and cooking. Adapt the amount to individual needs and circumstances.
recommendations.pet_adjustment_note: Pets are included in the household context, but this profile does not invent a numeric official pet-water allowance. Add a separate personal pet-water target when relevant.
recommendations.household_adjustment_note: Some people may need more water because of age, health, climate, diet or other individual circumstances.

recommendations.title: Food for one week
recommendations.advisory_note: Keep food that supplies enough energy and can be stored at room temperature, prepared quickly, with little water, or eaten without cooking.

recommendations.title: Radio independent of mains power
recommendations.advisory_note: MSB recommends a radio powered by batteries, solar cells or a hand crank.

recommendations.title: Long-term prescription medicine reserve
recommendations.condition_note: Relevant for people with long-term prescription treatment.
recommendations.advisory_note: MSB advises people with long-term prescription treatment to preferably keep medicine for one month at home.

recommendations.title: Alternative payment capability
recommendations.advisory_note: MSB recommends cash in smaller denominations and alternative payment options.

recommendations.title: Emergency supplies for pets
recommendations.condition_note: Relevant when the household has pets.
